name: Vaibhav Global Ltd
tagline: Vertically-integrated TV/digital value jewellery & lifestyle e-tailer (US/UK/Germany) with a real, structural operating-leverage story - FY26 EBITDA +26% / margin +140bps on just +9.2% revenue - but ~9-11% revenue growth and a bounded margin ceiling make this a quality-value re-rating idea, not a return-magnitude thesis
business_overview: Vaibhav Global sources and sells jewellery and lifestyle products via TV shopping and owned digital channels in the US (Shop LC), UK (TJC) and Germany, targeting middle-aged and older demographics with a vertically-integrated (Jaipur-based) supply chain and 60%+ gross margins. In-house brands are ~57% of B2C sales (target 60%+ by FY27), digital is ~44-45% of B2C (target 50% by end-FY27), and lab-grown diamonds have reached ~13% of retail revenue. Net-cash, ~24% ROCE.

ROCE ~24% (FY26), ROE ~15-18% - ROCE recovered sharply from mid-teens
Revenue Rs 3,692 Cr (+9.2% YoY), EBITDA Rs 399 Cr (+26%, margin 10.8% / +140bps), PAT Rs 266 Cr (+73.8%)

fundamentals_narrative: The operating-leverage thesis is now confirmed as real and structural, not an easy-comp artefact: FY26 revenue rose only 9.2% but EBITDA grew 26% and margin expanded 140bps to 10.8%, and Q1 FY27 continued it (EBITDA +37%, margin 11%, PAT +50%). The drivers are structural - in-house brand mix (~57% of B2C), digital channel shift with a lower platform cost base after the Shopify enterprise migration, lab-grown diamond penetration (~13% of retail), and cost discipline. The July 2025 tax tribunal ruling deleted ~Rs 150 Cr of demands, removing a contingent-liability overhang. The company is net-cash (Rs 296 Cr), earns ~24% ROCE and pays consistent dividends. What the deep read makes clear, though, is the ceiling: revenue grows only ~9-11% (FY27 guidance), TV shopping is a mature/declining Western format (Q1 FY27 TV revenue was still +9%, so not yet declining, but the terminal-value question is real), and operating leverage from a 10.8% EBITDA margin toward a historical 12-14% has a finite runway. This is a quality-value / re-rating idea, not a 10x.
technical_read: Not independently pulled. Notable market behaviour: the stock fell ~7% on the Q1 FY27 print despite +50% PAT and +37% EBITDA - the market keeps discounting the operating leverage, likely on the channel-transition and currency/tariff-noise concerns.

verdict_headline: Genuine, now-confirmed structural operating-leverage story at a cheap ~11x forward with net cash and 24% ROCE - but ~9-11% revenue growth and a bounded margin ceiling correct the thesis_fit from '10x-in-2-3-years' to 'neither'. A quality-value / re-rating idea. Conviction Medium, held.
verdict_reasoning: Deep-dive pass 1 (FY26 results + concall, Q1 FY27 results + concall, BSE announcements). The operating-leverage thesis is confirmed: FY26 EBITDA +26% and margin +140bps to 10.8% on +9.2% revenue, Q1 FY27 EBITDA +37% / PAT +50%, driven by structural mix shift (in-house brands ~57%, digital, lab-grown diamonds) and a lower cost base after the Shopify migration - Simrat's 'easy comp' concern is substantially answered.

But this is a ~9-11% revenue grower (FY27 guidance) with a margin-expansion runway that is finite (10.8% toward a historical 12-14%). A +12.7% Q1 FY27 (partly currency/tariff noise) is in line with guidance, NOT a growth inflection - the prior pass over-applied the trailing-average-vs-live-inflection rule. four_box score falls to 2.5 (tailwind weak: mature/declining TV format; tam no: no headroom for a return-magnitude thesis off Rs 3,750 Cr at ~9% growth; moat yes; valuation yes) -> thesis_fit corrected to 'neither'.

It remains a genuine quality-value / re-rating idea: net cash Rs 296 Cr, ~24% ROCE, ~11x forward P/E, consistent dividends, cleared tax overhang (July 2025 ITAT ruling, ~Rs 150 Cr), and a market that keeps discounting the leverage (7% drop on a +50% PAT quarter). Conviction held at Medium - the business-quality confirmation offsets the thesis_fit downgrade.

The unresolved risk: whether owned-digital growth can outrun TV-channel maturity before customer-acquisition costs erode the margin story. Q1 FY27 (TV +9%, not yet declining) softens but does not settle it.
No red flag, no conviction floor (no trusted signal). Re-check trigger: H2 FY27 prints (Nov 2026 / Feb 2027) - does EBITDA margin sustain toward 12%+ and does digital mix cross 50%.
